messages:
Nico: heads-up: publish blocked by a regen diff on sample app. looks like semver bumped because typegen picked up ordering-only changes.
Harper: can you paste the diff? ordering-only or real change?
Nico: ordering-only. example:
```
- paths/login.yaml
- paths/profile.yaml
+ paths/profile.yaml
+ paths/login.yaml
```
Nico: also one test toggles default retry config and leaks it to typegen output intermittently.
regen-bot: regendiff job #10521: 2 ordering-only files, 1 test drift.
Harper: quick fix: add deterministic key sort to typegen serializer and set CI regen to use it. i'll open a tiny CI patch.
Nico: can we also make the release gate ignore ordering-only changes? small policy tweak.
Harper: yep will update gate rule. ci-bot: build #10522: regen re-run with deterministic sort -> PASSED.
Nico: thanks. I'll add line to onboarding checklist: "if regen diffs happen, re-run with deterministic sort and file an issue."
Harper: PR for test teardown and stable order unit incoming.
ci-bot: build #10525: all samplekit jobs PASSED
Nico: closing thread, thanks :rocket:
